regions.why: "Main green, machine full: 1 passed, merges after the other, 1 waiting to launch" is "Breaks a rule today", and its two region states would show "Works today"

classes.end: Main green, machine full: 1 passed, merges after the other, 1 waiting to launch
classes.rule: "Work never stops flowing: once nothing more happens on its own and main is green, every pull request has merged."
classes.cause: a crew left an idle process running at its pull request, which jbus stops only once its row ended, so the machine stays full and the next row never launches

classes.end: Main green, machine full: 1 passed, merges after the other, 1 waiting to launch
classes.rule: "Once nothing more happens on its own, the machine has room."
classes.cause: a crew left an idle process running at its pull request, and jbus stops an idle one only once its row ended

classes.end: Main red from outside, machine full: 1 passed, waiting to merge, 1 waiting to launch
classes.rule: "While main is red and nothing else can happen, its fix waits only on your approval."
classes.cause: an idle process a crew left fills the machine, so even an approved fix for main cannot start

classes.end: Main red from a merge, machine full: 1 merged, 1 waiting to launch
classes.cause: its check selects the test that reads the whole tree only by chance, so a change that breaks that test merges
